text: うみで　ポケモンに　のるなら　ラプラスが　いいわ　おおきいから　ぬれない　もの

structure.jp: うみで　ポケモンに　のるなら
structure.en: if you're going to ride a Pokémon on the sea

structure.jp: ラプラスが　いいわ

structure.en: you don't get wet, you see

patterns.name: 〜なら
patterns.explanation: なら after a verb says 'if that is what you are going to do'. のるなら = 'if you're going to ride'.

patterns.name: 〜もの (reason)
patterns.explanation: もの at the end of a sentence gives your reason, in a soft, feminine way. ぬれない　もの = 'because you don't get wet'.

patterns.name: 〜から
patterns.explanation: から after a statement means 'because'. おおきいから = 'because it's big'.
